2|
3|The 30s heartbeat is gateway liveness, not a warning. Once a request has been
4|silent past the notice threshold this module decides WHAT the status line says
5|(neutral: which phase of the wait we are in, which watchdog would reconnect and
6|when) and WHETHER to rewrite it: once when the silence starts, again only when

8|retry policy live with the watchdogs; this is presentation only.
9|"""
10|
11|import math
12|from typing import Optional

14|NEAR_DEADLINE_SECS = 15.0
15|
16|
17|def _near_deadline(watchdog: Optional[tuple[str, float]]) -> bool:
18|    return watchdog is not None and watchdog[1] <= NEAR_DEADLINE_SECS
19|
20|
21|_PHASE_TEXT = {
22|    # Codex Responses (non-stream request path)
23|    "first_event": "{n}s waiting for the first provider event",
24|    "reconnect": "{n}s waiting for the first provider event after reconnect",
25|    "pre_progress": "provider stream open; {n}s without substantive model progress",
26|    "post_event": "provider stream active; {n}s without stream events",
27|    # Chat-completions streaming path
28|    "first_chunk": "{n}s waiting for the first stream chunk",
29|    "post_chunk": "stream open; {n}s without stream output",
30|}
31|
32|
33|def wait_notice_text(model: str, silence_secs: float, phase: str,
34|                     watchdog: Optional[tuple[str, float]] = None) -> str:
35|    """One neutral status line. ``watchdog`` is ``(label, seconds_until_it_fires)``."""
36|    lead = "still waiting on" if _near_deadline(watchdog) else "waiting on"
37|    text = f"⏳ {lead} {model} — " + _PHASE_TEXT[phase].format(n=int(silence_secs))
38|    if watchdog is not None:
39|        label, remaining = watchdog
40|        text += f" (auto-reconnect: {label} watchdog in {max(0, int(remaining))}s)"
41|    return text
42|

44|def codex_watchdog_deadline(*, silence_timeout: float, ttfb_enabled: bool, ttfb_timeout: float,
45|    last_event_ts: Optional[float], last_progress_ts: Optional[float],
46|    retry_started_ts: Optional[float], call_start: float, idle_enabled: bool,
47|    idle_timeout: float, idle_requires_progress: bool, elapsed: float,
48|    progress_timeout: float = 0.0) -> Optional[tuple[str, float]]:
49|    """Earliest enabled Codex watchdog as ``(label, seconds_until_it_fires)``; None when
50|    none applies (disabled/infinite, or its deadline already passed)."""
51|    deadlines: list[tuple[str, float]] = []
52|    if math.isfinite(silence_timeout):
53|        deadlines.append(("wall-clock stale", silence_timeout))
54|    attempt_offset = max(0.0, retry_started_ts - call_start) if retry_started_ts is not None else 0.0
55|    if last_event_ts is None:
56|        if ttfb_enabled and math.isfinite(ttfb_timeout):
57|            deadlines.append(("TTFB", attempt_offset + ttfb_timeout))
58|    elif progress_timeout > 0 and last_progress_ts is None:
59|        deadlines.append(("first progress", attempt_offset + progress_timeout))
